name: Blending Body (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: None

Benefit: The color of the alchemist’s skin better absorbs light, letting him remain better hidden in darkness. When in dim light, the miss chance due to concealment increases to 50% (rather than 20%); this does not grant total concealment, it just increases the miss chance.
